steps: Identify the given voltages: VL = 60 V, VC = 30 V, VR = 40 V.
Use the formula for supply voltage in a series LCR circuit: V = sqrt(VR^2 + (VL - VC)^2).
Calculate the net reactive voltage: VL - VC = 60 - 30 = 30 V.
Substitute values into the formula: V = sqrt(40^2 + 30^2).
Calculate the result: V = sqrt(1600 + 900) = sqrt(2500) = 50 V.
